summary: A person can now hold PIM delegations on their own existing account, which PIM Manager never changes.

new.title: Delegations on a person's existing account
new.text: The new admin type Existing account lets a person hold PIM delegations on their own office account. PIM Manager finds it by exact name and never creates, changes, disables or deletes it.

new.title: Warning on high-privilege use
new.text: PIM Manager warns you when such an account gets more than level 4-5.
